mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( product_code, product_name, category, unit, safety_stock, remarks ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{unit}, #{safetyStock}, #{remarks} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_code, product_name, category, unit, safety_stock, current_stock, remarks, reg_date, mod_date, del_yn FROM product WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name = #{productName}, category = #{category}, unit = #{unit}, safety_stock = #{safetyStock}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
